notes.title: We' ve Released the Game, and Upcoming Plans
notes.notes:
We have released the Steam version on 12/2.
So many people have already played the game and we have received both positive and severe feedback.
We are grateful to read your words.

We are currently working on the iOS and android versions.　The release will be next year and we plan to fix some bugs and implement the Chinese language.
We will continue to make the game even better.
Best regards

notes.title: We postpone the release and deliver the free public version
notes.notes:
I have two announcements regarding August 6.

1. We apologize for the delay. Due to quality improvement, we are postponing the release of this product. This will be the last postponement. Please wait a little longer.

We are planning to deliver by the end of this year, but we are working on it so that we can deliver before winter.


2. We will be exhibiting at Bitsummit in Kyoto.

https://bitsummit.org/en/

　Kazunari Suzuki (scenario) and Aogacho (art) will be there.

　We plan to start distributing 

  The free public version of the game on Steam on the same day.
